lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately six quasi-vertical columns posterior to the pectoral fin, forming a semi-regular grid distribution across the visible mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary circular blobs, creating discrete anchor nodes of maximum luminance at intersection points.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three parallel horizontal features on the upper third of the flank characterized by sharp vertical luminance gradients with high-intensity upper edges and shadowed lower margins.
